meta.name: add-tavily-tool
meta.description: Add Tavily Search and Extract as keyless remote MCP tools for selected NanoClaw agent groups. Use when installing Tavily web search or URL extraction without an API key.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 添加免密钥的搜索与网页提取能力到智能体组
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果在用 NanoClaw 管理智能体，希望它们能直接搜索网页和提取内容
copy.tagline_en: Add keyless web search and extraction to your agent groups.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you manage NanoClaw agents and want them to search the web without an API key.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会为选定的 NanoClaw 代理组安装 Tavily 的「搜索」和「网页提取」两个远程工具，无需 API 密钥即可用。免费额度耗尽时，Claude 会自动引导你创建密钥并完成切换。
howto.when: 当你要求给 NanoClaw 代理组安装 Tavily 搜索或网页提取、且手上没有 API 密钥时触发。

say.text: 给 dev-agents 组添加 Tavily，只保留搜索和提取两个工具。
Tavily 免费额度用完了，帮我走升级流程。
say.note: Claude 会提供密钥预填的升级链接。

howto.what_en: After install, Claude adds Tavily's two remote tools, Search and Extract, to chosen NanoClaw agent groups, usable without an API key. When the free allowance is used up, Claude guides you to create a key and switch over.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to add Tavily Search or web extraction to NanoClaw groups without having an API key.

say_en.text: Add Tavily Search and Extract to my NanoClaw group without an API key.
say_en.note: Claude runs the install and verifies the tools.

say_en.text: Add Tavily to the dev-agents group, keeping only Search and Extract.
My Tavily free allowance is used up; help me upgrade.
say_en.note: Claude offers a deeplink with your key prefilled.
